notes: Libretto by Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa (1896). Words follow the Ricordi vocal score's spelling and punctuation (Benoit without an accent, Mabil, Gl'anni, Per carita! without its accent, quant'anni, sconcie, pettorillo, the print's dots after signori..... and virtù). Arzuto and pettorillo are the friends' comic twists on Marcello's arzillo and pettoruto; the Mabil is the Bal Mabille, a Paris dance hall; sopracapi is Benoit's pun on grattacapi (headaches). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, words sung on one note joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced. Translation literal, for meaning.
